penetrationCheck.title: Penetration Check
penetrationCheck.intro: — which ships can its guns pierce?
penetrationCheck.noWeapons: This loadout mounts no guns with per-shot damage to test.
penetrationCheck.hoverHint: Hover a ship for the per-weapon breakdown.
penetrationCheck.note: Each selected gun is tested against every ship's shields and armor deflection with the same rules as the deflection check; a ship is pierced when any one of them gets through, and ranked by the gun that comes closest. Ships without armor are left out, since there is no threshold to cross.
penetrationCheck.ttkNote: Time to kill uses the selected guns' sustained damage per second, under the current power allocation, from the shield and armor health set above. Shields take the damage they absorb, less their resistance, and pass the rest to the armor, which takes it until it breaks and then hands it to the hull; distortion only ever drains shields. Shields regenerate only while every gun is paused for longer than their regen delay, and once down they stay down. Effective HP is the raw damage of one type it takes to destroy the ship, without deflection. Beams, marked TTK, count towards the time to kill only: armor never deflects them, and with no per-shot alpha they take no part in the margin. Missiles are left out.

deflectionCheck.title: Deflection Check
deflectionCheck.noArmor: This ship carries no armor, so nothing is deflected.
deflectionCheck.hoverHint: Hover a weapon for the per-type breakdown.
deflectionCheck.note: Alpha is compared per pellet, after the shield's soak — a gun pierces when it beats the deflection on any damage type. Types the shields absorb completely never reach the armor, so they are listed as absorbed rather than deflected: stopped by the shield, not the hull. Shield absorption interpolates across its published min–max range by shield health, and armor deflection scales linearly with armor health. Laser beams are excluded — they deal continuous damage, so there is no per-shot alpha to test.

hull.doorsNote: Breakable interior doors are a separate area — they carry their own health and are not part of hull HP.
hull.hint: Hull HP is the sum of all part health.
hull.partsNote: Parts are ranked by health; cosmetic parts (doors, ladders, flaps) carry no health of their own. The game files expose no parent/child links, so this is a flat list rather than a structural tree.
